topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The weight of the room feels heavy as I stand before my professor, accused of something I never intended. My voice is a mere echo in the silence, a fragile attempt to explain the similarities in the paper. I delve into the details, the countless hours spent researching, the late nights tied to my desk. Each word feels like a plea, a desperate effort to convey the effort, the authenticity of my work. It's more than just a grade; it's a testament to my commitment, my integrity. I can only hope my explanation finds a place in the shadows of doubt that have clouded this moment.
